g.text: Introduction to OSHA: Lesson 1: Introduction to OSHA (AI-written scenario, guide-sourced answer)
You are walking through the warehouse and notice a worker reaching into a drum labeled "Chemical" without
gloves. You hear a loud noise from the direction of the loading dock, and when you check, you see a forklift
operator has just dropped a pallet. The noise level near the loading area is around 85 dB. A worker mentions
they saw a spill earlier but didn’t report it. What applies here, and what do you do first, second, and third?
Think it through out loud, then press space to reveal the guide's answer. s skip esc back
